description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Lightning Stoneskin: 50%]/[50% Critical] to all allies if 0-3/4+ Type-0 allies are alive, grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Quick Cast 1] to the user, grants [Siphon Sword Follow-Up 1]/[Siphon Sword Follow-Up 2]  and AG Down +1 to the user if 0-3/4+ Type-0 allies are alive

description.name: Lightning Stoneskin: 50%
description.text: Reduces Lightning damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 50% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Siphon Sword Follow-Up 1
description.text: Grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the character's row after using a Spellblade ability

description.name: Siphon Sword Follow-Up 2
description.text: Grants [Siphon Sword 60% Critical]/[Siphon Sword 70% Critical]/[Siphon Sword 80% Critical]/[Siphon Sword 90% Critical]/[Siphon Sword 100% Critical] to all allies after using 1/2/3/4/5+ Spellblade abilities
